name: atc-cache-tax
description: Claude Code mod: holds a big prompt once when the prompt cache has expired and shows what re-caching the conversation costs, and /atc-keepwarm keeps the cache warm while you're away with cheap pings that stop by themselves. /atc-cache-tax shows the cache's state. Works on Windows, macOS and Linux. Requires Claude Code 2.1.287+.

guard.title: When the cache has expired
guard.description: ask: a prompt that would re-cache 50k+ tokens is held once with the cost, and Enter sends it. notice: it is sent, and the cost is shown. off: nothing.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: auto: worked out like Claude Code does (one hour on a Claude subscription, five minutes otherwise, unless promptCacheTtl or CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL says else). 5m or 1h: what you know it to be.
